```python
import numpy as np

def tranche_price_mc(rho, model, N=100, p=0.05, D=0.07, A=0.10, sims=200000, seed=7, chunk=20000):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
    c_g=norm.ppf(p)
    c_t=t.ppf(p, nu)
    sqrt_rho=np.sqrt(rho)
    sqrt_1mrho=np.sqrt(1-rho)
    total=0.0; n_done=0
    while n_done < sims:
        m=min(chunk, sims-n_done)
        M=rng.standard_normal(m)
        W=rng.gamma(nu/2.0, 2.0/nu, size=m)
        Eps=rng.standard_normal((m,N))
        if model=='gaussian':
            q=norm.cdf((c_g - sqrt_rho*M)/sqrt_1mrho)
        elif model=='t':
            q=norm.cdf((c_t*np.sqrt(W) - sqrt_rho*M)/sqrt_1mrho)
        else: raise
        defaults=(Eps <= q[:,None]).sum(axis=1)/N
        tranche=np.clip((defaults-D)/(A-D),0,1)
        total += tranche.sum()
        n_done += m
    return 1 - total/sims

def sens(model):
    h=0.01
    p0=tranche_price_mc(rho0, model)
    p_up=tranche_price_mc(rho0+h, model)
    p_dn=tranche_price_mc(rho0-h, model)
    return (p_up-p_dn)/(2*h)
```
